Messages.Author: Erik Albertsen
Messages.Body:

*detailed* rarities (i.e. U2, C3, etc...) Is there one available???

2. I just read somewhere (I think it was on this newsgroup) that locquipments

"Ok, I steal your Cathedral with my fast hands" or "I crush Dartmoor with a

No, sorry.

>2. I just read somewhere (I think it was on this newsgroup) that locquipments
>count both as locations AND equipments. Can this be true? How does this fit
>into the storytelling side of V:TES?
>"Ok, I steal your Cathedral with my fast hands" or "I crush Dartmoor with a

No. It only counts as equipment during the equip action. After that (once
it is in play), it's only a location.

Messages.Author: Morninglord Calamar
Messages.Body:
>2. I just read somewhere (I think it was on this newsgroup) that locquipments
>count both as locations AND equipments. Can this be true? How does this fit
>into the storytelling side of V:TES?
>"Ok, I steal your Cathedral with my fast hands" or "I crush Dartmoor with a

>shattering blow".

If you get the most recent(maybe it's 2nd most recent by now) copy of The
Duellist it outlines that the Loc-Equipment cards cannot be stolen or
broken as per normal equipment cards in combat... only effects outside of
combat can steal/burn them(As for the Ravnos Darius' and Konstantin's
power, I presume that they can use their powers to steal Loc-Equipment,
but it doesn't say for sure)

Morninglord Calamar

Messages.Body:

I don't think there can be much doubt about Darius' power. He steals the
card right out of your opponents hand, at which point all, and only, the
rules for equipment apply. As for Konstantine, I'm less sure. It is
rather difficult, afterall, to walk off with a Paris cathedral.
